overview.lead: Orbita is a platform for assessing employees, managing career levels, screening candidates, and allocating rewards. Below is a short tour of every part of the system.

flow.title: How it works
flow.subtitle: Four stages. Each one feeds the next.
flow.s1Detail: Define org structure, users, catalog, career levels and rubrics. Done once, then tweaked over time.
flow.s2Detail: During a period, service records, customer feedback, training and other evidence pile up. Only VERIFIED evidence feeds the score.
flow.s3Detail: At the period's end the system computes a score from the rubric. AI only suggests — a human always decides.
flow.s4Detail: Within (specialty + rubric + period) we rank employees and allocate budget per policy. Payment is marked PAID by hand.

sections.title: The pages
sections.subtitle: What each page does and what it looks like.

settings.title: Settings
settings.what: The foundation of the whole system. Start here.
settings.why: No rubric means no assessment; no level means no salary; no catalog means nothing works.

employees.title: Employees
employees.what: Your workforce: each person is tied to a unit, position, specialty and career level.
employees.why: Assessment and rewards start from the employee profile.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.what: Hiring candidates: an invite token sends them an auto-scored assessment.
candidates.why: The final score and hire/reject decision are recorded here — never automated.

assessments.title: Assessments
assessments.what: Periods, evidence, scoring, reviews, appeals and promotion recommendations.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.what: Cohort ranking (specialty + period, minimum 3 people) and budget allocation per policy.
rewards.why: You mark payment PAID by hand — nothing is sent automatically.

checklist.title: First-time setup
checklist.subtitle: If this is your first look, go in this order.
checklist.s1: 1. Org units — describe the department / branch tree.
checklist.s2: 2. Users — invite the rest of the admins and managers.
checklist.s4: 4. Levels + salary bands — the career ladder.
checklist.s5: 5. Rubric — create a DRAFT, then activate it.
checklist.s6: 6. Open the first period and let evidence come in.
